description.value: Surfs Inn is a family-owned collection of five self-contained suites and cottages perched in the rainforest overlooking Ucluelet harbour on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The property is walking distance to the Wild Pacific Trail, local beaches, and a variety of restaurants and cafes, and sits 40 km from Tofino. Units range from individual cottages to a larger guesthouse suited for families or groups, each with a well-equipped kitchen.

address.value: 1874 Peninsula Rd, Ucluelet, BC, Canada, V0R 3A0
